searchText: > There's no extra per-tx gaslimit at the moment? <@!273808422753796097> There still is in the geth implementation atm but it is one of the riders that was removed from the spec so I am overdue to remove it from the implementaiton as well to match besu's 🙂 Well thanks to <@!301186049323958275> who made it readable, I have just published an article trying to give an easy explanation of what EIP-1559 is all about https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/changing-models-ethereum-fatima-ethernity-live/?published=t https://medium.com/@FatimaFlash/changing-models-ethereum-90f9b6069c1e Opened an EIP PR to remove what reads like a circular dep in the parameters definition https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2768.
